entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your close bond with your phantom helps you to focus your concentration .

Prerequisite(s): Spiritual interference class feature.

Benefit(s): While you are adjacent to your phantom or your phantom is within your consciousness, you receive a +4 bonus on concentration checks.
